verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of Workers request rate limits or concurrency caps. The community comment about 30s CPU time on the free tier and 15 minutes on paid plans is a secondhand execution-limit report, not documented rate or concurrency caps. AI Gateway's configurable rate limiting is an adjacent feature for limiting your own traffic, and the "tens of millions of instances" line is a scale claim, not a documented cap.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented rate limits and concurrency caps for APIs and functions so I can plan for scale
